channel.title: Calendar • Milton, MA

item.title: Zoning Board of Appeals — public hearing
item.description: September 14, 2026, 7:00 PM, Milton Town Hall. Public hearing on a variance sought to reduce the rear setback from 20 feet to 11 feet for an addition at 271 Pleasant Street.

item.title: Planning Board — regular meeting
item.description: August 26, 2026, 7:00 PM. Site plan review for 14 Adams Street, proposed conversion from retail to 18 apartments.

item.title: Conservation Commission — notice of intent hearing
item.description: August 20, 2026, 7:00 PM. Notice of intent for work within 100 feet of a wetland at 40 Brush Hill Road.

item.title: Select Board — regular meeting
item.description: September 1, 2026, 6:30 PM, Carol Blute Conference Room. Article 14 short-term rental by-law discussion.

item.title: Warrant Committee — FY27 capital plan
item.description: September 8, 2026, 7:30 PM. Review of the FY27 capital plan and a proposed debt exclusion.
